code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin), mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine, hyperkalemia), and abnormal coagulation (high INR, low PT). These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and impaired oxygenation. Immediate clinical evaluation and further investigation are strongly recommended.
